name: How long does a typical investment property renovation take?
description: Renovation timelines vary; minor updates take weeks, while extensive projects can take 2-4 months or more, depending on scope and unforeseen issues.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical investment property renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an investment property renovation varies greatly depending on the project's scope. A minor cosmetic refresh (paint, flooring) might take a few weeks. A more extensive renovation involving kitchen, bathroom, and some structural changes could take 2-4 months. Full gut renovations can extend beyond 4 months. Factors like permit acquisition, material delivery delays, and unexpected structural issues can all impact the schedule. A detailed project plan with a realistic timeline from your contractor is essential.
